'''Marksman barrels''' were a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] modification available for [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The barrels were designed with soldiers in mind, to give increased range and accuracy to rifles, but were also popular with [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Marksman barrels were two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and contained upgraded [[static pulse adapter]]s and a denser Galven circuitry pattern. Although made of lightweight material, the barrels made weapons awkward to carry and impossible to conceal due to their lengths.<ref name="AORC" /> Models of barrel available included [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s]] [[KX756 marksman barrel]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation's]] [[WQ80 barrel]] and [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[3300 Hawkeye sharpshooter's barrel]], all of which sold for 1200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marksman barrels were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
